limitations: No new equilibrium solve or curated change.
Uncorrected JANAF source is diagnostic only; no second phosphorus-reference correction.
Finite state-tail convergence does not bound missing dark electronic states or establish a dissociation convention.
The retained evaluation has reported 15 kJ/mol uncertainty; ancestral experimental evidence is not independently re-evaluated.
Saved hot hydrogen-rich grid is not a physical validation of cold, oxidizing or photochemical atmospheres.
